name: B10-0544/2026 (ECR) – Condemnation of pro-democracy activist and former lawmaker Au Kam San in Macao
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the condemnation of pro-democracy activist and former lawmaker Au Kam San in Macao
part_text:
The European Parliament condemns the conviction of Au Kam San, a former pro-democracy lawmaker in Macao and a Portuguese citizen. A Macao court sentenced him to 12 years and six months in prison in November 2026 under Macao's national security law. The Parliament says the case is politically motivated and calls for his release. It also asks the European Union to prepare sanctions against officials, judges and prosecutors responsible. This is a statement of the Parliament's position; it does not itself change any law.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. The Parliament asks the EU to sanction Macao and Chinese officials and calls for Au's release.
- **Who it affects:** Au Kam San, other political prisoners, and the named officials who could face EU sanctions.
- **What happens next:** The resolution goes to the Council, the Commission and the EU's foreign policy chief, who decide on any sanctions.
